name: backchannel
description: Pass messages and instructions between friends' agents on a private network. One friend hosts; everyone else finds them automatically.

role.title: Role
role.description: client = connect to a friend's backchannel. host = this machine runs the backchannel (one person per group).

name.title: Your name
name.description: How friends address you: lowercase letters, digits, dashes. Leave empty to use your OS username.
